values: Meta Utility Approval Tracker - US EN CC
GPT Real 200 v2 = first 50 Felipe seed + 150 rewritten GPT/Zeus copies with emoji, headline + body, and stronger card-specific concepts.
CSV export for SB should use UTF-8 with BOM when emojis are present. Use us-en-cc-gpt-real-v2-200-total-utf8-bom.csv for dashboard import.
Original GPT Real 200 had weak one-line style from ID 51-200; keep only for audit. Canary New 150 / Combined 206 were mechanical structure tests.
~200 approved messages per page/cluster; MGS sends 12 messages/day/page.
Run Approvals → F5 dashboard → fill GPT Real Tracker → rewrite rejects using real approved winners.
Copy ideas must be written by GPT/Zeus; scripts only format/validate/upload.
Do not edit approved copies; editing changes hash and resets approval.
